title: Achievements and rank / XP levels

XP levels (kill 10, headshot 5, capture 50, match 20, win 80) shown by the name button and on Stats, RANK UP toast. tools/achievement_test.gd in gate F.

title: Recent games in Find Games
body: Last 5 servers joined (Settings.recent_servers) listed in Browse with live ping via the server query.

title: Menu footer overlaps BACK on the Host screen
body: Reported with a screenshot. Footer now only shows with the main list, Host buttons share a row, and _fit_panels() scales any centred panel taller than the window.

title: Gun Game ends after one kill with Survival on
body: Reported: GG should be a free-for-all that only ends when someone really wins. Settings.survival / advance are now getters that are false in Gun Game (stored prefs kept); menu greys the boxes out for GG. Verified a GG match with Survival+Advance prefs on keeps going past kills.
